title: Deliver shared editorial policy to canned workers and assignment context APIs
description: Feature: Shared worker policy. Scenario: Policy before research. Given a live research assignment, when its worker is dispatched, then the shared editorial context enters the prompt before source research. Scenario: Current section policy. Given a changed section policy, when reporting, writing and assignment APIs fetch context, then they resolve the same current section and surface missing/unauthorized failures. Scenario: Budgeted context. Given required editorial policy, when evidence is compacted, then policy is retained intact or the request fails explicitly.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Worker dispatch now supplies canonical policy before research/reporting model execution; standard researcher/reporter/copywriter source requires and prepends context. Assignment API current-section lookup tests pass; Tactus sources validate. Stored ProcedureVersion sync and a generated-text GraphQL endpoint remain follow-up, so this story remains in_progress.
